ModMetaData.name: Honor.Society
ModMetaData.author: Honor Mod Series
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7 have separate builds. The 1.6.4871 reference build is code-validated only; direct gameplay testing is deferred. 한국어: 1.6/1.7 버전별 빌드이며 1.6.4871 참조 빌드는 코드 검사만 통과했고 실제 플레이 검증은 보류 중입니다. Honor.SocietyApologies before staging, witness social memories, one-day colony rumors, blood-family honor and repeated-insult rivals. The offender may offer; only the victim may accept. Both need to be awake and within 12 cells. Adds a 600-tick preparation window. Requires Core 0.2.2+ and Harmony (1.6: 2.x / 1.7: 3.x); NO DLC required. 한국어: 사과 제안·당사자 수락·목격·하루 뒤 정착지 소문·혈연 명예·반복 모욕 숙적. 결투 준비 전 600틱 여유가 있습니다. Core 0.2.2 이상과 Harmony 필수, DLC 필수 아님. Source: https://github.com/Ale6974/HonorModSeries Collection: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3825922644
